checks.description: Default outline/medium/enabled/writable/no error/empty uncontrolled value; two variants and three sizes; supported View props remain on structural root.
Editor slot name/hint/testID override lifted root values; root accessibility state merges over slot then owned disabled/readOnly/invalid win; structural root stays inaccessible.

tests.name: Input INP-001 INP-005 merges root and editor accessibility state without overriding owned semantics

checks.description: Internal focus target composes editor ref, not structural root ref, and all clear on unmount.

tests.name: Input composes the focus target with the inner text ref without redirecting the structural ref

checks.description: Native root props/ref, textInput and three icon replacement slots compile without multiline/search/combobox APIs.
defaultValue seeds once, edits including empty persist through changed defaultValue and notify once.

tests.name: Input INP-002 retains internally owned edits across defaultValue changes and reports each edit once

checks.description: Controlled empty string overrides default; edit only proposes value, owner rerender changes display without callback.

tests.name: Input INP-002 leaves controlled text unchanged until the owner writes back, including an empty string

checks.description: Disabled and readOnly each refuse internal edits while preserving current value; native editing/IME/clipboard obey platform TextInput.
Pairwise overlapping disabled/error/readOnly/focused/pressed/hovered/rest resolves exactly one boundary state; disable clears tracked focus/hover/press and reenable does not resurrect stale state.
Root and slot focus/blur/hover/press handlers all run alongside tracking; hover area remains editor rather than spacing/icons.

Root/contents/icon-text stack order places iconStart before editor, trailing group after; neither/first/both icons render, end2 alone is omitted and warns; underline exists only for underline variant.
Custom editor and icon components retain props/ref and component sizing without introducing interactive icon actions.
Editor is accessible textbox with disabled/readOnly/invalid owned values; readOnly is editable=false but not disabled and remains focusable; all wrappers/icons are inaccessible.
Native caret movement, selection, IME, clipboard and Tab pass through with no custom key interception; disabled skips Tab and readOnly remains readable/copyable.
UIA/AX announces editor name/value, disabled/readOnly/invalid and referenced error reason once; placeholder is not treated as a stable name.

All variant/size/state combinations match radius, minHeight from lineHeight plus external margins, zero editor padding/intrinsic linebox, gaps, padding, 16/20/24 icons and state-specific stroke/text/placeholder tokens.
Caller root style follows token styles, no native editor lineHeight is forced and underline owns exactly one base thin stroke.
External spacing/icon-area click requests pointer focus on eligible actual editor without stretching its intrinsic Text; disabled ignores, readOnly accepts and slot focusable override applies.
Review caret/glyph alignment, icon centering, scaling and constrained field dimensions on all renderers.
Keyboard-visible outline uses persistent dual ring with softened base boundary; underline adds one focus-color inset above existing edge; no competing native editor ring.
Error/readOnly boundary stays authoritative beneath additive indicator; disabled suppresses both; pointer modality hides indicator without moving focus or resizing field.
Native-confirmed self-focus respects slot/root eligibility, invalidates pending requests on detach/disable and follows nearest scene modality without local tracker.
Review ring exclusivity, clipping and contrast for both variants across normal/high-contrast themes and text/display scaling on all desktop targets.

limitations: Contract explicitly says high-contrast, scaling and theme visual qualification is not recorded.
Win32 native editor can report UIA IsEnabled=true despite editable=false and focusable=false; do not infer native enabled projection from unit disabled props.
Synthetic edits/ref objects do not prove native editing, focus confirmation, IME or pointer target geometry.
